== Overview ==
{{spoiler|book=ee-shadow-03-of-killers-and-kings|[[The Elder]] War was a massive, decades-long conflict that fundamentally reshaped the world. It began when a figure known as [[the Liberator]] initiated hostilities against [[Nakothi]], an action that stirred the [[Great Elders]] into various forms of activity. During this period, the [[Elders]]' responses were unpredictable; some engaged in combat with one another, others launched campaigns to eradicate humanity, and some acted without clear logic. The war featured celestial battles in the void and resulted in significant global instability, including physical upheaval of the earth itself. While some historical accounts refer to it as [[Kelarac]]'s War or the [[Battle of Candle Bay]], the conflict is most widely recognized by its primary name. The war eventually concluded with the defeat of the [[Great Elders]], an event that allowed humanity a period to rebuild, though it left behind lasting scars and fears regarding the potential return of these entities.}}
